brief:
US envoy Jared Kushner described Gaza's reconstruction as a "huge act of kindness," according to Al Jazeera English, even as the territory remains under Israeli bombardment. The characterization comes as debate intensifies over terms and conditions for any postwar rebuilding effort in Gaza.

Kushner's framing reflects the Biden administration's approach to linking reconstruction aid with broader diplomatic outcomes. The statement reflects competing priorities between humanitarian needs in Gaza and geopolitical negotiations shaping potential recovery efforts.
dek: As Gaza remains under Israeli bombardment, US envoy Jared Kushner calls its reconstruction a ‘huge act of kindness'.
title: Kushner calls Gaza rebuilding act of kindness amid bombardment
